pages.title: Wiring
pages.text: $(bold)The first electricity: cord, wire of every metal, junctions, connectors, pins, the wire cutter and the potato battery. Needs Copper Tools as well.$(br2)$(thing)Iron Age$(n), ring 3.$(br)$(thing)16 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Technician and Copper Tools.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Smelt 24 copper ingots$(n)$(br2)Pays 1 Focal Shard once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
